messages.content: User task: Summarize the most important points of today's news for me.

raw_response:
I don't have access to real-time news feeds or the internet. I can only work with data already on your laptop. If you have news articles saved locally (text files, RSS feeds, browser exports, etc.), point me to them and I can summarize those.
